notes.title: 0.2.1 - Lag Fixes
notes.notes: [p]This should help with overall performance, especially if you noticed your GPU usage being really high in certain menus. They'll have a bit less flash and flair but that's a worthy sacrifice in this case.[/p][p][/p][p]Blocks in the mine now no longer render when your camera isn't in view of them. This should help with performance. You shouldn't actually visually see any differences.[/p][p]The Evertree, Manage Units, Museum, and Level Up scenes no longer have a shader in their background. This should help with performance.[/p][p]Removed the fanciness of the Ascension scene as it was causing problems with certain GPUs.[/p][p]Fixed: Some typos.[/p][p]Fixed: Loading a Loadout does not properly remove unlocks that you no longer own.[/p]
